title: 3D Ising criticality with Platonic lattice superconducting qubits
abstract: Digital quantum simulation of 3D Ising (Wilson-Fisher) criticality on superconducting qubits using CFT-informed variational state preparation.
key_claims: CFT-informed variational prep of a 3D Ising critical state on hardware.
WRONG universality class/dimension for this project (3D WF, not the 2D minimal-model tower c=1/2, c=7/10).
